Class DisplayUtilities

java.lang.Object
application.DisplayUtilities
public class DisplayUtilities extends Object
This class creates functions that help with creating and setting properties of commonly used JavaFX components. This allows any class to access these functions and not have to reproduce them in multiple files.

    • createTextArea

      public javafx.scene.control.TextArea createTextArea(String text, Boolean wrap, Boolean edit, int xLocation, int yLocation, int xPrefSize, int yPrefSize)
      Returns a TextArea with the specified characteristics as defined in the parameters.
      Parameters:
      text - This is the text that will be displayed.
      wrap - This is a boolean that determines whether text will be wrapped.
      edit - This is a boolean that determines whether the TextArea will be editable by user.
      xLocation - This is the x coordinate.
      yLocation - This is the y coordinate.
      xPrefSize - This sets the x preferred size.
      yPrefSize - This sets the y preferred size.

      TextArea THis returns a TextArea with specified characteristics.
